summary: Frontend-only regression for two new DEWASA checklist fields in kader visit wizard. Logged in as kader11, started visit, picked first family, advanced through confirm to member-select, chose an adult member (Abdurrahman, Usia Dewasa 29 th), reached the DEWASA checklist. Both new fields render correctly with expected testids, options, and behaviors. Multi-select toggle works (3 active → 2 after toggling one off), single-select enforces exactly one active option. Fields coexist with existing DEWASA items and Skrining TBC section. Ringkasan shows 'Tidak ditemukan masalah' — informational fields correctly do NOT produce findings. Draft save works and returns to Beranda without errors.
critical_code_review_comments: QuestionField renders multi chips with same data-testid='<kode>-chip' for all options — fine for count-based assertions but individual chips are indistinguishable by testid; consider suffixing option index/name for future granular tests.
seed_data_creation: None — one visit saved as draft (existing family), no cases submitted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New DEWASA fields (RIWAYAT_KELUARGA multi + KB single) fully verified in wizard flow. Ringkasan correctly ignores them (no priority/finding). Login testids are login-username-input / login-password-input / login-submit-button.
